cohort: A 30-year-old pregnant woman with newly diagnosed dilated cardiomyopathy of unknown etiology and pulmonary arterial hypertension was admitted for elective cesarean delivery.
finding: Individualized anesthetic planning and collaborative multidisciplinary care are critical for optimizing maternal and neonatal outcomes in high-risk obstetric patients with peripartum cardiomyopathy and pulmonary arterial hypertension.
mod_finding: The successful anesthetic management was achieved during an elective cesarean delivery using a combined spinal-epidural technique for gradual onset of anesthesia and tight hemodynamic control.
